neutral_rate_invest_keyed.note: a readout of the (b)-tuned bridge, not a finding and not a new default: r* with its capex term (alpha_capex x the pace of tasks moving) replaced by alpha_inv x the change in investment / income (delta Vm K / income, %) since the start; the macro path, and so the required return, is unchanged; the demand layer (the central variant) is run on each r*. Bridge scale: alpha_capex converted at (b)'s start, where it was set; demand-layer scale: (1 - a1)/a_r of the IS curve (investment not replaced by other spending, an upper end). The series keyed to is replacement investment, the only investment in the quasi-static accounts; net investment (Vm dK/dt / income) is stored as a diagnostic only: the machine stock falls on every deep path, (b) included, so keying to it would lower r* further.
